name: vaderai
description: Real-time AI copilot for interviews and study sessions — TypeScript workspace (Electron desktop + shared protocol). The backend lives in apps/server and is a Java/Maven project, not a pnpm workspace member.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @vaderai/protocol build && concurrently -n server,desktop -c cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:desktop"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rimraf dist out && rimraf apps/server/target node_modules
